industry.note: The five-layer stack any independent property runs, whoever supplies it. This is the spine of most technical topics.

layers.role: Property management system — the hub. Rooms, rates, availability, guest records, folio.
layers.note: Hub-and-spoke: everything else integrates to this.

layers.role: Pushes availability/rates out to OTAs and pulls their bookings back in.
layers.note: Two-way sync is the whole point; one-way sync is how double bookings happen.

layers.role: The direct-booking checkout on the hotel's own site.
layers.note: This is the layer Kymbo sells. Commission-free by definition.

layers.role: Gateway + processor + merchant account. Authorization, capture, refunds, disputes.
Profiles, segmentation, pre-stay and post-stay email, loyalty.
layers.note: The asset an OTA booking denies you.

distributionSurfaces.name: Google free booking links
distributionSurfaces.note: Requires a connectivity partner (PMS, channel manager or booking engine) sending live rates + availability to Google. Shows as 'Official site'.

distributionSurfaces.name: Direct
distributionSurfaces.note: The website. The whole campaign thesis.

cms: headless CMS + JS framework (Next.js) for larger builds
seoCritical: JSON-LD schema: Hotel, LocalBusiness, AggregateRating, Offer, FAQPage
Core Web Vitals: LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS
